title: 第1章 胡隆第2章 人影第3章 面板
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
正午时分，烈日悬空。
环阳市南郊。
湖面波光粼粼，碎金涌动，静谧得像是一幅被凝固的风景画。
——啾！
骤然间，一道尖锐的鸣叫刺破了这份沉寂！
高空之上，一只灰鸟自高空敛翅俯冲，快如离弦之箭，一头猛地扎进湖面。
哗啦！
利爪精准地破开水流，激起一簇转瞬即逝的浪花。
待它再度振翅腾空时，爪间已多了一条拼命扭动的白色小鱼。
银白的鳞片在强光下反射出刺目的冷光，细小的身躯剧烈地挣扎着。
想要挣脱开利爪的束缚，重新进入水中。
然而，这个想法终究只是奢望。
那抓住它的鸟爪如同冰冷的铁箍，使其所有的反抗都显得徒劳而无力。
同时。
灰鸟毫不迟疑，双翅鼓动起沉闷的风声，挟着它的食物冲天而起。
随着它极速升高，移动，因为阳光而投下的细小阴影。
短暂地掠过下方那片湖中心岛屿上唯一的一片墙体呈灰白色的建筑群。
其中一座楼顶上，几个加粗的红色字体格外醒目。
——晨光精神康复疗养中心。
当然，当地人更习惯称之为晨光精神病院。

它静默地倒映在如镜一般的湖中心，灰白的墙体透着一股肃穆之气，与周遭的旖旎风光格格不入。
此刻，其中一栋住院部。
从外看去，所有的阳台外金属栏杆被设计成细密的网格，恍若一只巨大的鸟笼，将里面的人困在其中。
一个个穿着病号服的精神病人在其中走动，做着奇怪的动作，亦或者驻足自语。
此刻。
其中三楼一间独立的病房内，空气里弥漫着消毒水特有的、刺鼻的化学气味。
正午的阳光惨白而灼热，穿透一侧窗户网格围栏与玻璃，在一处的白色地面上映照出一片片破碎的、边缘锐利的光斑。
一道消瘦的身影处于在光影交错的碎片之间。
身上那件蓝白条纹的病号服显得有些宽大。
胸口印着的‘301’那串数字在光斑下格外的刺眼。
人影是一个二十来岁的青年，此刻坐在床铺之上，仰着脸，脖颈以一种近乎折断的、僵硬的角度拉伸着，仰望着一侧窗外的天空。
惨白的皮肤下是清晰可见的青灰色血管纹路。
他的双颊凹陷，并且呈现出那种被彻底抽干了精气神后的死白，不见半分活气。
惨白的皮肉紧贴着骨骼，勾勒出嶙峋的骨骼轮廓。
整个人，活像是一具被抽干了精气神的干尸。
只有那不时轻微起伏的胸口，证明了这人目前还是保持着活着的生命特征。
content_en:
At noon, the scorching sun hangs in the sky.
Southern suburb of Huanyang City.
The surface of the lake is sparkling, gold fragments are surging, and it is as quiet as a frozen landscape painting.
——Chirp!
Suddenly, a sharp cry pierced the silence!
High in the sky, a gray bird gathered its wings and swooped down from the sky. As fast as an arrow from the string, it plunged into the lake.
Wow!
The sharp claws broke through the water flow with precision, stirring up a fleeting wave of waves.
When it flapped its wings and took to the air again, there was a small white fish twisting desperately between its claws.
The silver-white scales reflected a dazzling cold light under the strong light, and the small body struggled violently.
I want to break free from the shackles of the claws and re-enter the water.
However, this idea is just a wishful thinking.
The bird's claws holding it were like cold iron hoops, making all its resistance seem futile and powerless.
at the same time.
The gray bird did not hesitate, its wings fluttered with a dull sound of wind, and it soared into the sky with its food.
As it rises and moves rapidly, tiny shadows are cast by the sun.
Briefly passing by the only gray-white building complex on the island in the center of the lake below.
On the roof of one of the buildings, several bold red fonts are particularly eye-catching.
——Morning Psychiatric Rehabilitation Center.
Of course, the locals are more accustomed to calling it Chenguang Mental Hospital.
It is silently reflected in the center of the mirror-like lake. The gray-white wall exudes a solemn atmosphere, which is incompatible with the beautiful scenery around it.
At this moment, one of the inpatient wards.
From the outside, all the metal railings outside the balconies are designed into a fine grid, like a huge birdcage, trapping the people inside.
Mental patients wearing hospital gowns were walking around, making strange movements, or stopping and talking to themselves.
now.
In an independent ward on the third floor, the air was filled with the pungent chemical smell unique to disinfectant.
The midday sun was pale and hot, penetrating through the grid fence and glass of the window on one side, illuminating pieces of broken light spots with sharp edges on the white ground.
A thin figure stood between the fragments of light and shadow.
The blue and white striped hospital gown on her body seemed a bit too wide.
The number '301' printed on the chest was particularly dazzling under the light spot.
The figure is a young man in his twenties, sitting on the bed at the moment, with his face raised and his neck stretched at an almost broken, stiff angle, looking up at the sky outside the window on one side.
Under the pale skin are clearly visible blue-gray blood vessel lines.
His cheeks were sunken, and showed the kind of dead white color that had been completely drained of energy, without any trace of vitality.
The pale flesh clung to the bones, outlining the rugged outlines of the bones.
The whole person looked like a mummy that had been drained of all its energy.
Only the chest that rises slightly from time to time proves that this person still maintains the characteristics of life.
